name: Jose R. Gonzalez
office: City of Cudahy, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jose R. Gonzalez is a former Cudahy City Council member who was appointed in 2018 and elected in 2020. During his six years in office, he served as vice mayor and mayor multiple times. He works as chief technology officer at the Los Angeles County Office of Education and is pursuing a doctorate in education leadership.

sentences.text: Jose R. Gonzalez is a former Cudahy City Council member who was appointed in 2018 and elected in 2020.

items.text: In 2019, as a council member, he asked the city manager to look into the lack of lighting on Clara Street. He also said the city was coordinating with Cudahy schools to enhance green spaces on school property.
